items.title: Amazon ECS Managed Daemons now support non-critical daemons
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now support non-critical Managed Daemons for ECS Managed Instances .

items.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B200 instances are now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) Region
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) P6-B200 instances accelerated by NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs are available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Hyderabad) Region.

items.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Jakarta) Region
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) P6-B300 instances are available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Jakarta) Region.

items.title: Amazon CloudFront announces API support for flat-rate pricing plans
items.blurb: Starting today, customers can subscribe and manage flat-rate pricing plans programmatically using the AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, CloudFormation, CDK, or the PricingPlanManager API.

items.title: Introducing Amazon Quick Max: 5x the usage for power users who want the most out of Quick
items.blurb: Amazon Quick now offers Quick Max, a new plan for power users who want to get the absolute most out of Quick.

items.title: AWS Gateway Load Balancer now supports TCP Reset for faster failure recovery
items.blurb: A WS Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) now supports sending TCP Reset (RST) packets when a target becomes unhealthy, is deregistered, or when a flow's idle timeout expires.

items.title: Twenty Years of jQuery: How a Little Library Rewired Web Development
items.blurb: jQuery, created by John Resig and released in 2006, is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML manipulation, event handling, animation, and Ajax. It enabled easier web development by providing an accessible API across browsers.

items.title: Audacity 4.0.0 Released
items.blurb: Audio Editor . Contribute to audacity/audacity development by creating an account on GitHub.
